entries.text: Rebranded the site from Cited to Answerable.
Added three audience tracks, B2B SaaS, consumer and e-commerce brands, and local and independent professionals, each with its own playbook index.
Added llms.txt detection to the scan as a new check, bringing it to 16 checks.
Added copy-paste JSON-LD fixes for failing schema checks, a robots.txt fix for blocked crawlers, and a robots.txt generator page for AI crawlers.
Added the tools directory, the About and Methodology pages, a sitemap and a robots.txt.
Published the first research report, on who controls a brand's AI representation, from 64 scanned sites.
Added shareable scan URLs and a benchmark strip to the homepage, and built the Pro page.
Added the privacy and terms pages and a 404 page.
Added per-IP rate limiting to the scan and aggregate counts of AI crawler visits to our own site.
Published the first case study, AgaOne Commodities.
Added the MCP server, with tools for scanning, fixes and playbooks, and its documentation page.
Fixed how the scanner reads encoded characters in a page title and meta description, and corrected the benchmark data for it. Scoring changes are listed in the methodology changelog.
Made the MCP server follow the 2026-07-28 specification and kept compatibility with earlier clients.
Added the llms.txt checker and the schema generator as tool pages.
Added agentic-commerce checks to the scan, scored separately from the 100, and documented them.
Added the citation tracking page and the homepage teaser, built from an anonymised sample run.
Added benchmark pages for the six categories.
Added the compare-two-sites page.
Added get_citation_prompts and get_citation_sample to the MCP server, with question sets for all 14 verticals.
Removed the crawler-access rows from the benchmark failure rates and showed blocked, limited and open counts per crawler in get_benchmark.
Fixed how the scanner reads a meta description that contains an apostrophe. Scoring changes are listed in the methodology changelog.
Added the playbooks index page and replaced the Playbooks dropdown with a link.
Rebuilt the agentic commerce and citation tracking pages.
Added an llms.txt file to the site.
Published the sample report, a real crawl of our own site, and the results dashboard.
Rebuilt the report dashboard with an executive summary, a heat matrix, a pages explorer, fixes and a Citations tab.
Added Organization and WebSite structured data and a Contact link to our own pages, then crawled our own site again: the whole-site score went from 69 to 83.
Rebuilt the Pro page and the homepage Pro band around the full-site report and a citation run.
Added get_methodology, get_research and get_sample_report, a playbook list and three prompts to the MCP server, and limited live-fetching tools per domain.
